modeReason: Three independent stories — a software firm's AI-era layoffs, a state's gas-plant permitting ahead of a new governor, and a UK regulator's clash with a tech giant over agent testing — each score at or above the relevance threshold, including stories not solely about industry, so the balance rule and the magnitude of the day both point to fresh.
phrase: A software firm plans to cut 10,000 jobs for the AI era. A state approved a big gas plant for AI data centers ahead of a stricter governor taking office.
phraseAlternatives: A tech company plans to cut thousands of jobs to adapt to AI. The same week, a state approved a huge new gas plant to keep AI data centers running.
A tech company refused to let a regulator test its new AI agent. Meanwhile, 42 state prosecutors raced to stop a bankrupt chatbot firm from auctioning users' private chats.
Chip shipments to several countries were paused to keep them from reaching a rival. A software company said it would cut thousands of jobs instead, citing the AI era.

brief.concept: A software company empties its offices into moving boxes while, across town, an official stamps a huge gas-plant permit for a data center before a new official can take over the role.
brief.metaphor: Two doors on one horizon: a company door losing workers to AI on one side, a permit door being stamped shut just in time on the other.

brief.composition: Split scene on the blueprint grid. Left half: an office building in cross-section, rows of desks, one human figure walking out through the door with a box, a small AI robot settling into the nearest empty desk. Right half: a smokestack and a boxy data center, a human official stamping a large permit between them in the single yellow highlight, a second official reaching a door just as it swings shut, briefcase mid-air. A shared horizon line ties both halves together.
brief.alt: On one side, a worker leaves an office carrying a box while a small robot sits down at the newly empty desk; on the other, an official stamps a large permit beside a smokestack and a data center as a second official reaches a door that has just swung shut.
